title: What Makes Digital Coaching Meaningful in Everyday Life?
summary: At CDHI, Park connected AI and digital coaching with trust, dignity, and the realities of aging.

sources.label: Read Chorong Park's original LinkedIn post

paragraphs.text: Intelligent systems also need to make sense to the people using them. Chorong Park explored that challenge in a June 1, 2026, keynote through the Centre for Digital Health Interventions, later sharing a reflection on August 19.

Drawing on ELARA's work in socially assistive robots, voice interaction, and technology for aging, Park asked how adaptive systems could be trustworthy, usable, and emotionally meaningful. Digital coaching offered a way to connect those design questions with everyday health and care.

The discussion brought personalization into conversation with dignity and technology acceptance. Park's reflection points to an important distinction: tailoring a system is not only a technical exercise; it also means understanding whether that support fits someone's life.

She thanked Tobias Kowatsch, Rasita Vinay, Felix Moser, and the CDHI team for the exchange. Questions about moving promising technologies into real care settings remained a central part of the conversation.
